gameplay.text: "Freestyle base with mandatory ones, explained under this!" — core technique: learn to dash-auto-attack-animation-cancel and perfect it (auto-attack, side-roll as soon as the damage pop-up appears, repeat). OP notes the rest of Maul's kit "does not require a lot of skill."

Maul is a bruiser class offering mobility and constant DPS/high burst depending on build. Spells are either "charged" or combo'd off one of the two combo-starters (Mighty Mjolnir / Mountain Breaker). Both ultimates are viable (can also be played with no ult), though JUBAI personally prefers Forge of War for its high-range heavy CC and CC-recovery (no-mobility builds are also playable).

Core loop: dash-auto-attack-animation-cancel (auto-attack, side-roll on damage pop-up, repeat). Combo starters (Mountain Breaker / Mighty Mjolnir) feed into Maelstrom or other follow-ups. JUBAI's framing emphasizes Mighty Mjolnir/mobility builds for learning players, with Maelstrom as the standout current-meta spell for dive/flank play rather than frontline trading.
